definitions.explanation: An intense, unwavering attachment to a goal, desire, or grudge. Can be used positively (admirable persistence) or negatively (unhealthy obsession or deep-seated resentment).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{執念|しゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}かされる→驚かす：01918_odorokasu⟧。
examples.english: I am amazed by his tenacity.

examples.japanese: {執念|しゅうねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かなえた。
examples.english: She achieved her dream through sheer determination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{執念|しゅうねん}{深|ぶか}く⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}い→追う：02016_ou⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: It was found that the perpetrator had been persistently pursuing the victim.

notes:
USAGE:
{執念|しゅうねん} implies a powerful, almost supernatural force of will. It can describe admirable determination toward a positive goal or frightening obsession and vindictiveness. Context determines whether the nuance is positive or negative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {執念|しゅうねん}{深|ぶか}い (tenacious, persistent — often negative)
- {執念|しゅうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{燃|も}やす→燃やす：02318_moyasu⟧ (to burn with determination)
- {執念|しゅうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧ (a victory won through sheer tenacity)
- ⟦すさまじい→すさまじい：07674_susamajii⟧{執念|しゅうねん} (fierce determination)
